moments.title: National Remembrance Sunday
moments.blurb: Today, the UK observes Remembrance Sunday, with the National Service of Remembrance taking place at the Cenotaph in Whitehall to honour those who served and sacrificed.

source.l: Royal British Legion / Time and Date

angles.name: Solemn Observance
angles.copy: Today, we pause to remember. The National Service of Remembrance takes place at the Cenotaph, a solemn moment for the UK to honour those who gave so much. #RemembranceSunday

angles.name: Poppy Appeal
angles.copy: Wearing your poppy with pride today as the nation unites for Remembrance Sunday. Let's ensure their sacrifices are never forgotten. #WeWillRememberThem

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Updates

angles.copy: King of Pop still reigns! Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' just hit No. 5 on the UK Singles Chart. What a Halloween legacy! #Thriller #MichaelJackson
